## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). Mixed signals: VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND and ↓ falling (fear easing) versus credit stress reading (HYG/LQD shows stress rising) supported by HYG (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41%) BELOW TREND.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing (VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling) and persistent credit/credit-sensitivity friction (HYG/LQD signaling credit stress ↑). Commodities/oil strength (USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND; BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND) also supporting pockets of cyclicality.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral financial conditions: SPY/TLT in RECOVERY with SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION; Dollar muted (Dollar metric CORRECTION) and yield-curve below trend.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities showing strength per breadth (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%) — use XLU proxy. Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND but overall sector breadth weak; Style: mixed, with commodity/cyclicals pockets.

**5. US vs Global?**
US steady: SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND. EM outperformance: EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND and China recovery signs via FXI (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.19%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows elevated: IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND; small-cap IWM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.75%) in RECOVERY — appetite exists but breadth is narrow.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity-led market: USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND driving cyclical pockets; CPER (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -1.99%) RECOVERY; GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy clearly strong: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND — commodity reflation dynamics intact.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Energy (XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND) and broad market resilience (SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND). Divergences: weak sector breadth (4/11) and mixed credit/fear signals (VXX falling vs HYG/LQD stress) — minor divergence but enough to temper conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and EM ETFs (XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND; EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to cyclical industrial pressure (XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND) and monitoring credit via HYG (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17%) CORRECTION.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Industrials and Consumer Discretionary — XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil — USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Select ags on short-term pullbacks — WEAT (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +11.68%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~17.72 (complacency zone if <20), HYG/LQD ~0.7505 (credit stress signal), XLK/XLF ratio 3.2234 (style tilt), SPY near short-term support/resilience zone (SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, VXX falling but credit indicators show stress. Energy and EM showing strength; key risk is narrow breadth and mixed credit/fear signals to monitor.
